title: Quantum mixing for eigenfunctions of rational polygons in configuration space
summary: The Shnirelman-Zelditch-Colin de Verdière theorem and its weak mixing extension relate quantum ergodicity and quantum mixing with ergodicity and weak mixing of the geodesic flow. Integrable systems, such as the flat torus, do not satisfy either in general. Restricting to position-dependent observables, Marklof and Rudnick established equidistribution for almost all eigenfunctions of rational polygons.
